headline: Commercial terms belong in your books, not on a public explorer.
sub: QuietBooks · Private B2B Invoicing & Shielded Settlement on Midnight
vo: Every business transaction settled on a public blockchain leaks what companies spend the most effort keeping quiet: pricing, customer lists, and revenue cashflow. QuietBooks fixes this on Midnight. The commercial terms never touch the chain, while the cryptographic proof never leaves it.

headline:
A Dual-Ledger
Invoice Explorer.
sub: Public lifecycle anchors · Status & pseudonyms visible · Commercial terms 100% locked
vo: Here is the QuietBooks dashboard. On Midnight, the chain records that an invoice exists, its due date, and four thirty-two-byte digests. To any third party or competitor, the amount is completely locked and invisible. Privacy is the default, not an afterthought.

headline:
Issue confidential terms
without mempool leaks.
sub: Line items, tax, and currency kept in private witness memory · 9 blinding salts derived locally
vo: Issuing an invoice is seamless. The supplier defines unit prices, tax rates, and payout bindings. The client derives nine blinding salts locally in zero-knowledge witness state. Only the root commitment is anchored to Midnight. Zero plaintext touches the mempool.

headline:
Atomic Shielded Forwarder:
settleWithNote.
sub: receiveShielded + sendImmediateShielded in one call · Contract balance change is zero
vo: Settlement solves the custody paradox. Midnight contracts publish held balances. So QuietBooks uses an atomic forwarder. The buyer's shielded coin is received and immediately passed to the seller via Z-swap. Contract balance change is zero, amounts stay private, and the circuit proves the coin matches the invoice exactly.

headline:
8-Stage Selective Audit,
mathematically proven.
sub: Disclose amount & tax to an auditor · Line items stay opaque · Canonical byte serialization
vo: Selective audit reconciles privacy with compliance. When an auditor asks for proof, the seller grants access to only amount and tax. Our client-side validator enforces canonical serialization to defeat JSON duplicate-key smuggling, proving the numbers fold into the on-chain root while line items remain strictly secret.

headline:
Zero-Knowledge Architecture,
built for real money.
sub: 12 entry points fit inside Substrate 50KB block write limits · Bound payout addresses · Anti-confetti token checks
vo: Under the hood, QuietBooks is engineered around Midnight's real constraints. We measured Substrate block limits to fit exactly twelve entry points, bound payout addresses to prevent self-payment attacks, and enforced token-type matching to eliminate counterfeit coin exploits.

headline:
285 Unit Tests.
18 Mutants Caught.
Real ZK Proofs.
sub: Zero mocked contracts · 27/27 E2E steps · 15/15 two-party shielded money transfer
terminal: e2e two-party settlement (15/15 passed): REAL TOKENS MOVED
vo: Nothing is mocked. QuietBooks is backed by two hundred and eighty-five passing tests, eighteen mutation tests that catch hostile provers, and live two-party settlement on Midnight localnet where the seller's balance rises and the amount is absent from block data.

headline: QuietBooks: The Private Payments Layer for Midnight.
sub: 1,246 lines of original Compact 0.23 · React 18 UI · Apache-2.0 · Wave 1 AKINDO Buildathon
vo: QuietBooks is built on twelve hundred and forty-six lines of original Compact zero point twenty-three code, with a production React interface and developer CLI. Open source under Apache 2.0. QuietBooks is the private payments layer for Midnight. Thank you.
